'''Lutrillia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], on the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. An important export of Lutrillia was [[ochroid dust]].

==Geography==
It was a cold, arid planet of windswept tundra with endless, remarkably level continents. Once, the planet was home to shallow seas, but they dried up over the millennia, leaving but a handful of oases.

==Society==
Lutrillia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of nearly 800 million [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]]. The native Lutrillians evolved a nomadic lifestyle to avoid subterranean predators, and to visit widely dispersed water sources. This lifestyle adapted to modern technology, with over one hundred wheeled platform-cities crossing the planet at its equator, stripping the surface of food, water, and [[Iron/Legends|iron]] ore. Half of the cities traveled east and half traveled west. Many thousands of smaller vehicles transported passengers and cargo between these rolling behemoths. Additionally, since a stalled vehicle would likely become prey to such burrowing predators as [[nipper]]s and [[chomper]]s, spare parts were a critical import.
